claims.text: Andaman Polymer Group has taken a final investment decision on a third polypropylene line at its Map Ta Phut complex in Thailand.

citations.quote: Andaman Polymer Group has taken a final investment decision on a third polypropylene line at its Map Ta Phut complex in Thailand.

claims.text: The third polypropylene line at Map Ta Phut is designed for 300 kta and will use gas-phase technology, consistent with the site's existing two lines.

citations.quote: The line is designed for 300 kta and will use gas-phase technology, consistent with the site's existing two lines.

claims.text: Propylene for the third line will be supplied from the existing Map Ta Phut propylene unit, and no additional cracker capacity is required.

citations.quote: The company said propylene will be supplied from the existing Map Ta Phut propylene unit, and that no additional cracker capacity is required.

claims.text: Mechanical completion for Map Ta Phut PP Line 3 has been revised from the second quarter of 2028 to the fourth quarter of 2028.

citations.quote: The company said mechanical completion has moved from the second quarter of 2028 to the fourth quarter of 2028.

claims.text: The delay in mechanical completion was attributed to a longer-than-expected environmental permit amendment process for the revised flare tie-in and a schedule extension requested by the civil contractor due to unsuitable ground conditions requiring additional piling.

citations.quote: Two factors were cited. First, the environmental permit amendment covering the revised flare tie-in took longer than the company had assumed in its original schedule. Second, the appointed civil contractor requested a schedule extension after encountering unsuitable ground conditions at the foundation stage, which required additional piling.

claims.text: Andaman Polymer Group stated that the capital estimate for Map Ta Phut PP Line 3 is unchanged and the delay does not affect the existing two polypropylene lines or the cracker.

citations.quote: Andaman said the capital estimate is unchanged and that the delay does not affect the existing two polypropylene lines or the cracker.

coverage_note: All claims are directly supported by company press releases. No evidence was found for operational events beyond the construction schedule update and FID announcement.
